//: Deliberately one rule, not a preset (D162).
A style preset on a Tailwind stylesheet spends its time complaining about
@apply and @tailwind and about conventions this project has already
decided, and the noise is how a linter gets switched off. What this exists
to catch is one thing, and it is a thing that shipped: four duplicate
.select blocks sat after the intended one, and because CSS takes the last
of equal specificity they were the rule actually in force. Four properties
of a deliberate design were silently overridden, including the light
theme's chevron, for as long as nobody diffed the file against itself.
no-duplicate-selectors fails on exactly that and on nothing else.
